summary: Anchored floating surface with light dismiss, for non-modal content opened from a trigger.

usage.text: Put the toggle element in the trigger slot, or point the anchor attribute at an outside element; a click on either toggles the surface. From script use show(), hide(), toggle() or the reflected open attribute.
The surface is a native popover="auto": an outside press or Escape closes it, and the open attribute and the open-change event follow.

a11y.text: The component gives the surface no role or name and sets no aria-expanded on the trigger. Put a role and label on the slotted content, and update the trigger's aria-expanded from the open-change event.
